_note: A PATH with baseline_ref compares whole screens with the legacy capture and may also carry image_check_ids (checks the UI model declares; their nodes must be nodes the baseline observed). A PATH without baseline_ref carries image_check_ids alone and needs no runnable legacy app: coverage names a frozen UI target and node_ids include the node of every carried check. Every declared check must be carried by some visual PATH.
